---
title: "2026 Florida Primary for Governor"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
  message: false
  warning: false
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tigris)

# Extract the 67 county files to a temporary folder and read the key columns
files <- unzip("2026-pri-outputofficial.zip", exdir = tempdir())

gov_votes <- read_tsv(
  files,
  col_names = FALSE,
  col_select = c(county = 2, office = 12, candidate = 15, party = 16, votes = 19),
  quote = "",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  filter(office == "Governor", party %in% c("DEM", "REP"))

# Sum votes by Democratic candidate statewide
dem_candidates <- gov_votes |>
  filter(party == "DEM") |>
  summarize(total_votes = sum(votes, na.rm = TRUE), .by = candidate)

# Plot total votes by candidate in the Democratic primary
ggplot(dem_candidates, aes(x = total_votes, y = fct_reorder(candidate, total_votes))) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title = "2026 Florida Democratic Primary for Governor",
    subtitle = "Official statewide vote totals by candidate",
    x = "Total Votes",
    y = NULL,
    caption = "Source: Florida Division of Elections"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 11

# Compare Republican and Democratic primary votes by county
county_party <- gov_votes |>
  summarize(total_votes = sum(votes, na.rm = TRUE), .by = c(county, party))

ggplot(county_party, aes(x = total_votes, y = fct_reorder(county, total_votes, .fun = sum), fill = party)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("DEM" = "steelblue", "REP" = "firebrick"),
    labels = c("DEM" = "Democratic", "REP" = "Republican")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title = "Governor Primary Votes by County and Party",
    subtitle = "Comparing Democratic and Republican primary turnout across all 67 counties",
    x = "Total Votes",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Party",
    caption = "Source: Florida Division of Elections"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Join county vote totals with Florida county map boundaries
county_summary <- county_party |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = party, values_from = total_votes, values_fill = 0) |>
  mutate(
    county_key = str_to_lower(county),
    dem_share = DEM / (DEM + REP)
  )

fl_map <- counties("FL", cb = TRUE, progress_bar = FALSE) |>
  mutate(county_key = str_to_lower(NAME)) |>
  left_join(county_summary, by = "county_key")

# Map the balance of Democratic vs. Republican primary votes across counties
ggplot(fl_map, aes(fill = dem_share)) +
  geom_sf(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "firebrick",
    mid = "white",
    high = "steelblue",
    midpoint = 0.5,
    labels = scales::label_percent()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Republican vs. Democratic Primary Vote Share by County",
    subtitle = "Blue counties cast more Democratic primary votes; red counties cast more Republican primary votes",
    fill = "Dem Share\nof Primary Votes",
    caption = "Source: Florida Division of Elections & U.S. Census Bureau"
  ) +
  theme_void()
```
